meta.method: One Elasticsearch query (guest endpoint, POST): description has "temporary" and one of event, marquee, festival, stage, market, fair, funfair, ice rink, pop-up, filming, concert, exhibition; site centroid in the zone box; newest 300 by last update; applications validated more than two years before the fetch are counted and dropped. Dates: decision date, else the application valid date (the event dates are in the application documents only).
